title: Kurosaki san no Ichizuna Ai ga Tomaranai

overview: Actress, producer and animal advocate Hilary Swank and Michael Levitt are re-teaming with FOX to executive-produce the second annual The All-Star Dog Rescue Celebration, a one-of-a-kind event celebrating America's rescue dogs. Throughout the two-hour family-friendly special, celebrity guests will introduce the audience to adoptable rescue dogs and honor the people who dedicate their lives to caring for animals in need. The All-Star Dog Rescue Celebration will also raise awareness of dog-related issues and encourage people to adopt one of the more than eight million rescue animals currently in the U.S. shelter system.
title: The All-Star Dog Rescue Celebration

overview: Love Thy Neighbour follows Eddie Booth after he leaves England and moves to Australia, continuing his story from the original British series of the same name. Arriving on his own while his wife and child remain back home, Eddie struggles to find his place in a new country, clashing with his Australian neighbours and workmates as his blunt opinions and short fuse collide with local attitudes and customs.
title: Love Thy Neighbour

overview: In this season, MrBeast pushes contestants and himself into the toughest survival experiments imaginable, from one hundred days in bunkers and circles to freezing expeditions and isolation tests. Every scenario is designed to strip life to its basics and reveal who has the strength, patience, and ingenuity to endure.
title: MrBeast: Extreme Survival!

overview: When an unassuming dad's daughter goes missing, he dusts off his old black-ops skills to track her down — only to attract the wrong kind of attention.
title: Agent Kim Reactivated

overview: Yummy Mummy is a totally unique and ultra hip half-hour weekly parenting series. Set in an interactive virtual environment, it's unlike anything you've ever seen. Hosted by the real deal, yummy mummy Erica Ehm and her eclectic mix of experts, celebrities and yummy mummy guests will celebrate and commiserate the joys and challenges, payoffs and perils of being a modern day parent.
title: Yummy Mummy

overview: Here Family offers a realistic view of raising children within the LGBT community. Covering topics such as non-traditional breastfeeding, surrogates, invitro or adoption, and domestic partnership, the series explores the art of balancing a family with our hectic lives. Also included are celebrity interviews and money-saving tips.
title: Here! Family

overview: The Perfect Special for Christmas Day! TV's Funniest Holiday Moments is a Paley Center for Media Special holiday event hosted by Jane Lynch. The two-hour special will count down the Top 40 holiday moments of all time gathered from holiday sitcoms, dramas, variety specials, late-night programs, and sketch shows. Relive television's most memorable holiday scenes and laugh, cry and remember the reason for the season. Some of the programs celebrated in this special are Cheers, Married... with Children and Friends.
title: TV's Funniest Holiday Moments

overview: Top actress reborn as a general's daughter, allies with a prince to outwit foes and unveil a bloody conspiracy.
title: A Queen Reborn

overview: A snooker prodigy turned delivery driver. A deadly bet. A decade-old murder waiting to be avenged. Once unbeatable, Cheng Ye lost everything when his girlfriend was killed during a rigged match. Now going by "Black Eight," he drifts through the city delivering food until a chance encounter drags him back into the game. The truth behind her death was never what it seemed. To uncover it, he must pick up his cue again. But the man who destroyed his life is watching, and every step toward justice brings him closer to the edge...
title: Rack 'n' Roll Delivery

overview: A sinister chant of witchcraft rings in her ears like a demon's whisper. As warm blood runs across her palm, Feng Li opens her eyes to find her dagger buried deep in her father's heart. Watching him collapse, she lets out a scream of utter despair. The moment her mother orders her imprisoned in the Cold Palace, Feng Li knows her life has ended on her fifteenth birthday. When she sees daylight again, she is no longer a fallen princess but the newly enthroned empress—her name steeped in infamy, reviled by all. She cares little for the scorn, indulging in pleasure and excess, her smile seductive and unrestrained. During the imperial consort selection, Feng Li's gaze locks onto Yun Moxiao at first sight—she senses a kindred soul. Tracing the scar on his shoulder, she asks with a teasing smile, "They say I murdered my father and brought ruin upon my mother. Aren't you afraid of me?" He whispers at her lips, "If it pleases Your Majesty, my life is yours to take at any time." Their eyes meet—one glance, a lifetime. Old lovers reunite, yet everything has changed. Who would recognize them now as the princess of Wutong Kingdom and the heir of Fusang, once bound beneath the wutong tree by a vow of marriage and happiness? Now, she hides behind a carefully crafted facade, swearing to tear open a rift in this dark and corrupted world. He, having lain dormant for years in a death prison, carries the hatred of a fallen kingdom and has returned with a single purpose: to take her life. Inside and beyond the palace walls, danger lurks in every whisper, conspiracies breeding like ghosts. A lethal entanglement of love and assassination is about to erupt.
title: Sharp Blade in the Snow

overview: Natalie and Victor Alfonso must confront the social class differences that threaten their love. Witness what they are willing to overcome to find happiness.
title: La Fiera

overview: Daniela Montenegro and Santiago Rodríguez fall in love at first sight. However, the shadow of a tragic past casts a shadow over their story: Horacio, Santiago's father, murdered Daniela, Daniela's mother and the wife of his business partner and friend, Diego Montenegro, 20 years ago. To avoid prison and protect his family, Horacio manipulated the evidence to frame Diego, who was sentenced to 25 years in prison. Now that Diego is about to be released, Horacio will do everything in his power to eliminate him, and Daniela and Santiago will find themselves caught in a struggle to reconcile their violent past and overcome other obstacles to consummate their love.
title: Pobre Diabla

overview: Mel Brooks: The 99 Year Old Man! explores the life, career, friendships, and loves of legendary writer, director, producer, and performer, Mel Brooks. One of Hollywood's most daring satirists from the early years of television sketch comedy through his film and stage hits, Brooks has held a funhouse mirror up to the human condition and used laughter as a path to resilience, connection, and joy for nearly a century.
title: Mel Brooks: The 99 Year Old Man!

overview: Brandon Bernier and his wife Lori are the toughest players in this high-stakes game of bid or be out-bid.
title: Storage Hunters

overview: After some challenging months Jill Dillard and Jessa Seewald are ready to look towards the future. Originally known as "Jill & Jessa: Counting On" now renamed Counting On, follows the oldest Duggar children as they begin to their life as adults and start families of their own. Jill and Derick Dillard return home from Central America and readjust to living in Arkansas. Jess and Ben eagerly await the arrival of their second child, while Jinger plans her wedding to her new fiance, Jeremy Vuolo. Joy Duggar also begins a courtship with her childhood friend, Austin Forsyth.
title: Counting On

overview: Three brothers seek revenge on the family who they think are responsible for the death of their younger sister, but have a change of heart when they fall in love.
title: Gavilanes

overview: On one sunny summer day Oleg Bardin (Egor Beroev) sets free from a maximum security prison. He had been imprisoned for 12 years for robbing a bank armored car and now only one thing he wants is to forget about the past and start a new life with Nadezhda - a woman who loves him - and his son Andrey. But stolen and missing 18 million dollars haunt many people. And there are a lot of bad people and bad troubles apart from Nadezhda waiting for Oleg at the prison gates. Eight days in which the action takes, turn upside down the life of almost all the characters. The film is full of conflicts, twists and turns, chases, sudden deaths and deep human love.
title: Дорога на остров Пасхи

overview: The meteoric rise to fame. The break-up that broke hearts. The comeback that changed everything. How did five lads from Manchester rewrite pop history?
title: Take That

overview: When a young doctor discovers that children living near a smelting plant suffer from lead poisoning, she risks her career and safety to save them.
title: Ołowiane dzieci

overview: A supposed luxury maven. A detective with a keen eye. As he digs into her shifting story, the truth behind a murder case slowly comes to light.
title: The Art of Sarah

overview: Isolated on a deserted island, ten celebrities compete to handle a state of emergency. Each night, they must banish one person. Who will be the last survivor?
title: Kode rød

overview: Agent Tørr is an absurd crime parody. The series follows PST's legendary, but hopelessly clumsy special agent Harrbjørn Tørr, who is repeatedly brought out of retirement to save Norway.
title: Agent Tørr

overview: American Diner Revival is bringing back the diner, one town at a time. Chef Amanda Freitag and home improvement expert Ty Pennington are joining forces to resurrect the local diner, turning establishments from rundown to charming. Find out where they're headed to next.
title: American Diner Revival

overview: Barbeint i Snøen (en.: Barefoot in the Snow) is a powerful story about Lina and the dramatic events that occur. One November evening in 2022, a young Norwegian woman walks into a Swedish seaside hotel. She is scantily clad and not wearing shoes. The following evening, she is found naked and dead outside a summer house not far away. The murder alarm goes off.
title: Barbeint i snøen

overview: Johan Golden is pissed! He has been abused in a crypto scam on Facebook. Golden is therefore taking up the fight against one of the world's most powerful men. The new series "Golden vs. Zuckerberg" is a documentary series in which Johan Golden decides to sue the tech giant Meta. Golden reveals the dark sides of Meta's influence on the world and meets others who have been affected by the company's irresponsible practices. It is not only Johan Golden who wants to hold Meta accountable. Before Christmas, it became clear that the Norwegian Media Association is also considering taking legal action against the tech giant. It is a massive problem that, according to Reuters, Meta earns around $16 billion annually on fraudulent ads.
title: Golden vs. Zuckerberg

overview: Ulf's father invited Sheik Talal Al Saud to Sweden. Excited Ulf promised everyone on the block a real, live, Arab prince, not realizing there has been a change in plans. So now he's got to do something.
title: Min vän shejken i Stureby

overview: Semaga is a master of painting nesting dolls, an "old school" person: he loves wood, manual labor and an order in which a man is the head of the family. His track record includes the smallest matryoshka doll in Russia. But times are changing, Semaga is losing his job, and his wife Violetta is rising up the career ladder. Family relations are strained, the teenage daughter considers her father to be boring, and only the eight-year-old son still maintains a warm relationship with his dad. After being fired from the matryoshka workshop, Semaga feels like she is finally losing control of her own life. In a desperate attempt to regain the respect of his family, he decides to open a nail salon – together with his friend, the asshole Antokha. Confident that he can handle nails as easily as he can with nesting dolls, Semaga suddenly finds himself in the world of gel coatings and women's conversations. And this new experience is changing him more than he could have imagined.
title: Мистер Ноготь

overview: In the first life, they are twins. The older one was called Kasalong who was raised by her mother who taught her to be sweet and gentle. She is also good at north dancing and household tasks. Since she is of good values and nature, everyone compared her to be godlike. The younger was called Songpeep raised by her father is cruel and selfish just like him, she was always jealous of Kasalong because she thought that her mother loved Kasalong more than her. She played the victim in all situations and would go around seducing guys who fought for her. She was the complete opposite of her sister even when it came down to simple things like their clothing. Since she was of these values, people always thought ill of her. Both of them tragically die. Songpeep is engulfed in fire due to her anger while Kasalong gets trapped and dies from malnutrition. In the second life, Songpeep was reborn as Pimpisa, the daughter of a wealthy doctor.
title: Klin Kasalong

overview: Oliver Cromwell is the great bogeyman of Irish history. His name appears everywhere in the collective psyche of the island. He is a towering figure, a dark silhouette against the bloodstained backdrop of history. But why did he come to Ireland, and does he deserve this black reputation? For the first time in this major television series we get a serious insight into Cromwell the man Cromwell -God's Executioner, is an epic but very real, gritty and bloody portrait of warfare in the 17th century.
title: Cromwell in Ireland

overview: Miguel Ángel is a member of one of the richest families in the city, while Estrellita is a poor, beautiful, and hardworking girl who sells newspapers to earn a living.
title: Cara sucia

overview: Engineers, back-yard tinkerers and various other catapult aficionados meet once a year in Delaware for the World Championship Punkin Chunkin catapulting competition.
title: Punkin Chunkin

overview: Nerea García is going through a rough patch. Four years have passed since she was expelled from the Ertzaintza (Basque police force), and she lives in isolation, confined to her home in Bilbao. The discovery of a woman's body, murdered in some kind of ritual, leads her former boss to ask for her help with the investigation.
title: Zeru Ahoak

overview: When a centuries-old shipwreck is discovered in the depths off the coast of Copenhagen, historian Cecilie Nielsen sets out to discover what secrets the wreck holds. She closely follows the marine archaeologists from the Viking Ship Museum in Roskilde, who are faced with one of their most spectacular tasks in years: excavating and salvaging the ship. Together with Denmark's leading medieval researchers, historians and archaeologists, she tries to solve the mystery: What ship lies here? Where did it come from? Who sailed with it? And why did it end up here?
title: Gåden i dybet

overview: Mariana del Carmen Guerra is a humble young woman caught in a family drama when it's discovered that her stepfather secretly recorded intimate videos of her and posted them online. The situation escalates, complicating Mariana's life to the point where she has no choice but to run away from home. Without intending to, and having never planned for such a fate, she ends up invading the dressing room of a cheerful young man, Sergio Martínez Aldana, without him noticing the unexpected intruder. Thus, in her unexpected struggle for survival, Mariana will meet the love of her life. However, the story of these young lovers will not be a bed of roses. Mariana's arrival in Sergio's life will cause a series of disputes between the young man and his family. Because of these problems, Sergio will lose his inheritance and his family position, and will be rejected by his father. From this complicated situation will emerge a wild and exciting love story.
title: La Invasora

overview: María arrives in San Luis, Argentina, after a failed marriage. Battered by life, she seeks to reconnect with her roots, with part of her family, and ultimately, with her true self. What María doesn't know is that in this place she will rediscover love and that the possibility of becoming a mother will become increasingly real.
title: Sálvame María

overview: Do you dream of a house that needs a little extra love? Join Einar Nilsson as he visits families who are turning their dreams into a living reality.
title: Nytt liv i gamle hus

overview: Join us on a trip! Meet the people, hear the stories and experience nature along our most spectacular stretches of road. This is a Norwegian holiday at its best!
title: Nasjonale turistvegar

overview: "The League" is a competition-driven comedy series where it's not enough to win - you have to challenge yourself and impress with both showmanship, creativity and humor.
title: Ligaen

overview: A two-part film on Benito Mussolini and fascism, presented for the first time in colour. It is the story of fascism's violent roots, and its dream of restoring the glories of the Roman Empire. Benito Mussolini became well known as the leader of the National Fascist Party and the main founder of fascism after his return from WWI. The war had altered his outlook on life; once a reformer, he became obsessed with the idea of power and started to refer to himself as Il Duce. His apparent successes and glorification of violence encouraged Adolf Hitler to organise Germany on the same fascist principles. "FASCISM IN COLOUR" provides a fascinating yet disturbing account of Il Duce's desire for power, his totalitarian dictatorship and his alliance with Hitler that led to the death of 55 million people. Based on descriptions of events written at the time; letters, diary entries, secret memos and telephone taps, this is a truly remarkable record of the man who ultimately became Hitler's pawn. Rare archival colour footage keeps Il Duce's arrogance and his ruthless rule of violence, intimidation and murder very much alive. Produced and Directed by Chris Oxley ; An IWC Media co-production for Channel Five in association with Discovery Channel
title: Fascism in Colour

overview: The Heisman Trophy Presentation is an annual event that awards the greatest trophy in NCAA College Football history to the athlete designated as the most outstanding college football player in all of North America for the current season. Known initially as the DAC Trophy, it was first presented on 9 December 1935. Following the death of John Heisman in 1936, the DAC Trophy was renamed the Heisman Memorial Trophy as a fitting tribute to the memory of one of the greatest distinguished American athletes and coach ever associated with College Football. Since 1993, ESPN has aired the Heisman Trophy live from the Downtown Club, formerly known as the Downtown Athletic Club in New York City. It is typically an 90 minute-long program featuring interviews with past winners and nominees (with their families and/or coaches).
title: Heisman Trophy Presentation

overview: Ancient Celtic tales featuring magical beasts, presented by poet and singer Twm Morys
title: Celtic Monsters

overview: Battleplan is a military-based television documentary series examing the various military strategies used in modern warfare, since World War I. Each episode looks at a particular military strategy (or "battleplan") used in warfare, through two well-known historical examples and compares them both with the military requirements needed in order to conduct that "Battleplan". All the episodes use examples from modern warfare, dating from the First World War (1914–18) up to the recent Iraq War (2003).
title: Battleplan

overview: Hase Taiga who has been working part-time at the small restaurant "Tanomi" for three years, was once a promising young man as the ace of the university's relay team, but his past was ruined by poor performance. Although he doesn't have any particular dreams at the moment, he is beginning to feel a sense of fulfilment in his work, such as being entrusted by the owner with coming up with new menu items. Meanwhile, Park Rin, from South Korea, a graduate student studying animation is busy working on her assignments. Just when she feels relieved after somehow managing to submit her assignment just before the deadline, she receives a notice to move out of her student dormitory... However, for a foreigner, finding housing in Japan is not an easy task, and she is exhausted both physically and mentally... Then the two have a chance encounter at Tanomi. Rin is moved by the onigiri Taiga serves her, and her hunger and tiredness are gradually satisfied. Taiga is captivated by Rin's smile as she eats them deliciously. And the moment their eyes meet, an irresistible thrill flows between them.
title: Gimbap and Onigiri

overview: After launching a low-cost computer in the US, Jonas Marra becomes one of the world's leading technology entrepreneurs. Mysteriously, he decides to return to Brazil 20 years later.
title: Geração Brasil

overview: A multigenerational saga (1887-1917) parallels a bee colony, with the queen representing family roots and tradition. The Pichanda family faces love, work, crisis, and war, weaving reality with dreams.
title: Tisícrocná vcela

overview: A teenager disappears causing her family's world to turn upside down. In the police quest to find her, all her relatives will become suspects of her kidnapping.
title: ¿Dónde está Elisa?

overview: Follow the adventures of Dina, a genie who after 500 years locked in a lamp, is released and joins a widower and his two children, and finds that everyone has something to hide.
title: ¡Ala... Dina!

overview: Life on Tour is a new reality series that follows musicians on tour as they explore cities across America exclusively on the Travel Channel.
title: Life on Tour

overview: Mintra feels like she's in a fairytale when she finds the perfect guy to marry, Peem. But Jack, a charming model, shows up at their wedding ceremony without invitation. He and Peem are secretly lovers and now Jack is the presenter of the new product Peem's company is launching. Everything changes as soon as Jack comes into Mintra's life. She knows that Peem is having an affair with him, but can't get a divorce since she needs money for her sister's treatment. She finds confort in Ton, her junior, who's secretly in love with her. Meanwhile Jack is angry that Mintra is disrupting his relationship with Peem, and tries to get her out the way, but she won't back down in the hope that Jack will give up. Peem refuses to choose between the 2, and forces them all to live together, uncaring of Jack and Mintra's feelings.
title: บ่วงเสน่หา

overview: The story is about an Isan singer named Yodrak who ends up taking the place of a marine officer who vanished due to the two looking very similar to one another as if they were twins. Because of their differing personalities and skills, people start to suspect him, especially his fiancée who happens to be a doctor for the navy.
title: Yodrak Nakrob

overview: A suspicious audio CD is delivered to Shiroyama Kyosuke, president of Hinode Beer, exposing the company's past wrongdoings. Meanwhile, a group of men—including Monoi Seizo, a pharmacy owner, and Handa Shuhei, a detective—plot to steal money from Hinode Beer. Detective Goda Yuichiro investigates Shiroyama's disappearance, only to find a note saying, "The company president is in our custody." Shiroyama is soon released, and a criminal group, Lady Joker, claims to have poisoned 3.5 kilolitres of beer, demanding 2 billion yen from the company.
title: Lady Joker

overview: Poom Rattanabodin hires Yai Mangeaw as his wife to stand in place of his girlfriend, Deurnchai Chattrakorn, while she is in school abroad in Japan. He hires her so that he wouldn't have to be forced to marry the girl, Prakaifah Sopapan, that his parents want him to marry. As the story goes on, Poom starts to fall in love with Yai and so does she, but she tries not to fall in love with him because his girlfriend is her best friend and she owes her friend a great value because of an issue that she and her family helped solve.
title: Jao Sao Chapor Kit

overview: Blue Skies is an all-new procedural series blending mystery, action, and emotional storytelling, centered on the powerful bond between a detective and her canine companion. Set in the stunning Crystal Ridge National Park, the series follows former military police officer Jodi Larsen as she returns to her hometown to serve as a criminal investigator for the National Park Police. As Jodi protects the park and its visitors from both natural and human threats, she navigates a new team, personal loss, and an unexpected partnership with Blue, a mischievous stray Labrador whose instincts prove invaluable in solving cases. The canine, Blue, a golden Labrador Retriever is played by three brothers, River, Comet and Canyon. River is considered the "star" of the three.
title: Blue Skies

overview: This is the story of Máximo, a man who falls in love with the woman who has been transplanted the heart of his dead wife, killed in an accident.
title: Máximo corazón

overview: Wild Connection is a documentary series that explores the intricate biological and geological links between distant regions of the planet, specifically focusing on the Iberian Peninsula and Central America. The series chronicles the dramatic formation of landscapes, such as the closing of the Isthmus of Panama, and tracks how these events allowed for the migration and evolution of a diverse array of species, from the Spanish ibex and brown bears in Europe to jaguars and monkeys in the tropics. By examining these "forgotten places" and unique splendors, the show illustrates how isolation and connection have shaped the earth's most fascinating animal worlds across two different hemispheres.
title: Conexión salvaje

overview: When a scandal-ready queen in trouble meets a mysterious, two-faced "knight," who will fall first? He becomes her personal assistant, but is he after something, or is he the one falling for her? When a quirky little "witch" falls for a cold-faced hacker, is it really one-sided, or are they both running toward the same love? Ever met someone who makes your heart pound like a startled deer? When sparks feel like destiny, will you dare to chase true love?
title: This Is the Feeling of Love

overview: This winter, America will brace itself for the ultimate Christmas count-down competition — a fantasy camp for Santas! In this heart-warming holiday special event, ten Santas from across the country are brought to live in a barn to compete with each other in an array of hilarious challenges meant to determine who most lives the "Santa Way". These would-be St. Nicks have to vote out their peers over the course of 8 episodes, all counting down to a Christmas Eve grand finale where the last Santa standing will win $100,000 and the title of America's Best Santa on truTV's Santas in the Barn.
title: Santas in the Barn

overview: Young doctor Olga leaves a prestigious work in Moscow and moves to provincial town to become the doctor in the small local hospital.
title: Земский доктор

overview: A single mother quits her career as a professional singer to become a bounty hunter chasing down deadbeats dads.
title: Бывшая жена

overview: Award-winning evolutionary biologist Dan Riskin attempts to understand the mysteries of the mind that make us human in brand new series ‘Human Nature'. Travelling around the globe, Dan takes a detailed look at different aspects of the human psyche, from our relationship to fear, to the significance, power and potential of memory.
title: Human Nature

overview: Life of Bona Sforza, 16th century Italian princess from Bari, who became wife of king Sigismundus I the Old and queen consort of Commonwealth of Poland and Lithuania.
title: Królowa Bona

overview: The tactical reality taking place in Costa Rica was not the viewers' votes, but the daily happenings taking place between the characters, conflicts shape the outcome: the hotel tempt players, taktikáznak, conspire, thus affecting who can stay and who should go. During the game, anything can happen, old players leave, new ones arrive, thoroughly disrupting the established balance of power and emotion. It is not only the goal is to find someone to pair, is much more important to know who how to take a structured strategy and emotionally influence the others to do their own victory. It offers 10 players will move on, but already in the first week there are unexpected twists that stir up the newly formed pairs spiritual world.
title: Éden Hotel

overview: Forty robberies, two escapes, 28 years behind bars. Uncover the truth behind Australia's most infamous fugitive, Brenden Abbott. This is the real story behind BINGE Original RUN.
title: The Postcard Bandit

overview: A teenage girl disappears after a party, sparking an intense search that uncovers dark family secrets. As a detective struggles to solve the case, the apparent stability of the wealthy León family begins to crumble.
title: ¿Dónde está Elisa?

overview: 90 Day: The Single Life - Between the Sheets will air after each episode as a companion show, serving up all the juicy extras. Cast members, their former spouses/exes, plus family and friends spill behind-the-scenes drama, share unfiltered reactions, and say what everyone else is thinking.
title: 90 Day: The Single Life - Between the Sheets

overview: The Coach Vick Experience is an emotional, high-stakes docuseries that follows Michael Vick as he returns home to Virginia for the biggest challenge of his life — stepping in as a first-time head coach tasked with reigniting Norfolk State's struggling football program. With the community and the season on the line, Coach Vick must learn the job in real time while building a team hungry for greatness. At its core, this is more than football - it's a raw and inspiring look at what it takes to rebuild a program, a culture, and the belief that anything is possible.
title: The Coach Vick Experience

overview: Meet Sereia, a young and beautiful singer whose world of fame and fortune is interlaced with envy and hate. Her murder in the midst of carnival shocks the entire country and the hunt for her killer reveals a new suspect with each new day of investigation. Holding the status of a big-budget thriller, the miniseries brings about mysticism, sensuality and suspense that hooks the viewer until the astonishing end.
title: O Canto da Sereia

overview: An adventure series for young viewers. A group of children, accompanied by their guardian, Filip, arrive at a sanatorium for allergy sufferers. Inside an old piano, they discover stairs to a hidden room containing a mysterious device. It's a Change Machine. Whatever, or whoever, is placed inside it transforms into something entirely different. The children's guardian takes on the role of guinea pig in an intriguing experiment. He enters the Machine. Moments later, a real rabbit emerges from the device.
title: Maszyna zmian

overview: Earth from Above is a series of documentaries, presented by Yann Arthus-Bertrand and dedicated to the major challenges faced by our planet, It was broadcast on France 2 and France 3, French national television. "Earth From Above" brings the viewer beautiful High Definition images of the Earth. Each episodes talks about a particular environmental challenge.
title: La Terre vue du ciel

overview: Film-maker Nigel Marven goes on an epic journey following the journey of grey whales on their 5,000-mile migration.
title: Whale Adventure with Nigel Marven

overview: After four years as an intern in "I Kveld med Ylvis" Magnus Devold finally gets his own talkshow. He will make celebrity news as only the Americans have done until now. Magnus Devold refuses to passively sit and wait for the good stuff. Armed with zero integrity he goes on making up his own newsstories.
title: Kjendiskveld med Magnus Devold

overview: A resident of Copacabana and Cinara's fiancé, Donato lives a life above suspicion. But he is actually a serial killer, obsessed with women dressed as brides.
title: As Noivas de Copacabana

overview: For decades, a quiet Mennonite farming community in Canada hid a secret no one saw coming: a family-run drug empire stretching from rural Ontario to the mountains of Chihuahua, Mexico. NARCO MENNONITES uncovers the astonishing rise of the Harms family, the original architects of the "Mennonite Mafia," and the violent new generation that followed. Through insight from insiders, traffickers, and pursuing law enforcement, the series reveals how a peaceful religious community became an unexpected pipeline for cartel power.
title: Narco Mennonites

overview: A look back at the rise, fall and lasting impact of the most sensational era in TV talk show history. By exploring the psychological forces that shaped the talk TV genre, the series reveals how these shows transformed from trusted confessional spaces into lightning rods of controversy, leaving a lasting impact on culture, media and the people caught in the chaos.
title: Dirty Talk: When Daytime Talk Shows Ruled TV

overview: Story of a girl who tries to take out the bitter truth of her life but fall in love with someone whose family member constantly reminds her past.
title: Maryada: Lekin Kab Tak?

overview: «После школы» is an innovative blend of storylines and lyrical digressions, embedded video clips and musical interludes, comedic techniques and detective twists, stylizations and parodies. The film's soundtrack consists of iconic nostalgic retro compositions and ultra‑modern, upbeat songs.
title: После школы
